summary: Genesis submission paths now always emit prev_entry_hash anchored at GENESIS_HASH when the ledger is empty.

defect.invariant_violated: Every ledger entry, including the first, must carry prev_entry_hash anchored at the fixed ledger genesis hash.
defect.impact: The first-entry append path could produce a schema-invalid or invariant-invalid ledger entry even though validate_ledger.py and the append invariant model already required genesis anchoring.

fix.manual_submit_path: submit_entry.py now computes the next chain anchor as last-line hash or GENESIS_HASH.
fix.workflow_submit_path: accept-submission.yml now emits GENESIS_HASH when ledger.jsonl has no prior entries.

governance_still_open: assay-ledger main still requires zero approving reviews
assay-ledger main still has enforce_admins disabled
